decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cutting and creasing product with likely low carrying cost, it remains worth keeping open for another year even though the lack of visible new traction after two seasons raises the abandonment probability somewhat.

The UV spot varnishing system is the riskiest option because it is farther from the established range, but its flagship role in print enhancement and digital finishing still justifies keeping it on the market while management learns a bit longer.
Because the B2 multifinisher is both strategically highlighted and tightly aligned with the firm's core postpress automation business, real-options logic continues to favor retention.

The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the familiar booklet-making domain and there is no strong negative signal, so management would normally keep this option alive despite somewhat higher review pressure after two years.
As a complementary folding add-on with at least one reference installation and low expected portfolio cost, it is still economical to keep available while broader demand becomes clearer.
